clauses.summary: 25 psi at every service connection under normal operating conditions
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: 20 psi at all service connections during unusually heavy flows (fire, flushing)
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: a boil water advisory (precautionary) for loss of pressure in the distribution system or a significant portion of it
clauses.citation: SC DES, Boil Water Notices and Advisories (2024), advisory situations
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: a precautionary boil water advisory prior to a hurricane making landfall, for a zone at risk of losing pressure
clauses.citation: SC DES, Boil Water Notices and Advisories (2024): advisory prior to a hurricane making landfall
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: a boil water notice when sampling confirms a threat (fecal-positive routine and repeat sample)
clauses.citation: SC DES, Boil Water Notices and Advisories (2024), notice situations
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: notify the Department immediately on issue and on repeal; forward a copy of each notice as soon as possible
clauses.citation: SC DES, Boil Water Notices and Advisories (2024), communication with the Department (R.61-58)
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: verbal notice may go first to critical customers and the county EMA; written notice within the release window
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: after a pressure loss: intense flushing once pressure is restored, then coliform samples across the area; repeal if coliform is absent
clauses.citation: SC DES, Boil Water Notices and Advisories (2024), suggested actions after issuance
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: a notice after positive samples lifts when at least two sample sets taken at least 24 hours apart show no coliform
clauses.citation: SC DES, Boil Water Notices and Advisories (2024), suggested actions after issuance
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: a pre-hurricane advisory is repealed if the system did not lose pressure and water quality was maintained; otherwise the pressure-loss actions apply
clauses.citation: SC DES, Boil Water Notices and Advisories (2024), hurricane advisories
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: lift only when all total coliform results are negative and SCDES agrees
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: 20 psi at each service connection under all conditions of flow; a boil water advisory when pressure falls below it or integrity is lost
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: notify the EPD district inspector before the public notice where possible; written copy to the district office within the copy window
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: release the approved notice within the release window; phone hospitals, dialysis centres, nursing homes and schools directly
clauses.label: F

clauses.summary: rescission: integrity restored and positive pressure held, mains flushed, samples from at least half of the coliform sites (or the 15 to 20 samples the EPD inspector accepts), all total coliform negative, sampled no sooner than 24 hours after flushing, EPD concurrence
clauses.citation: GA EPD boil water protocol (A-085); SGW WQC 07.114 sections 6.4.1 to 6.4.4
clauses.label: A
